req.title: List all tasks
req.statement: The system shall respond to GET /tasks/ with a JSON array of all tasks, honouring optional skip and limit query parameters.

doc.reasoning: R-TASK-004 requires GET /tasks/ to return HTTP 200 with a JSON array of all tasks, honouring optional skip and limit query parameters. Three tests are designed: (1) positive/EP – default call with no query params returns HTTP 200 and a JSON array of all seeded tasks, tracing to R-TASK-004; (2) boundary/BVA – skip=0 and limit=1 returns exactly the first task, exercising the minimum-limit boundary; (3) negative/NEG – limit=0 violates the ge=1 constraint and must be rejected with HTTP 422, covering the error_pathways clause. All tests use an in-process SQLite override via FastAPI dependency injection so they are fully self-contained and deterministic.

tests.name: test_list_tasks_default_returns_all_seeded
preconditions: FastAPI application is importable from app.main
Database is seeded with exactly 5 tasks before the request
actions: Override get_db with an in-memory SQLite session seeded with 5 tasks
Send GET /tasks/ with no query parameters

tests.executable:
import os, tempfile
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app
from app import models
from app.database import get_db

tf = tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(suffix='.db', delete=False)
tf.close()
DB_URL = f'sqlite:///{tf.name}'
engine = create_engine(DB_URL, connect_args={'check_same_thread': False})
models.Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)
TestingSession = sessionmaker(autocommit=False, autoflush=False, bind=engine)

db = TestingSession()
for i in range(1, 6):
    db.add(models.Task(id=i, title=f'Task {i}', description=f'Desc {i}', completed=(i % 2 == 0)))
db.commit()
db.close()

def override_get_db():
    d = TestingSession()
    try:
        yield d
    finally:
        d.close()

app.dependency_overrides[get_db] = override_get_db
client = TestClient(app)

r = client.get('/tasks/')
assert r.status_code == 200, f'Expected 200, got {r.status_code}'
data = r.json()
assert isinstance(data, list), 'Response body must be a JSON array'
assert len(data) == 5, f'Expected 5 tasks, got {len(data)}'
for item in data:
    assert 'id' in item, 'Each task must have id'
    assert 'title' in item, 'Each task must have title'
    assert 'completed' in item, 'Each task must have completed'

app.dependency_overrides.clear()
os.unlink(tf.name)
